dioramas.title: Yuzu Capybara Onsen
dioramas.subtitle: Snowy Hot Spring
dioramas.description: Two blissful capybaras soaking in a steaming volcanic turquoise spring, with a balanced yuzu citrus, bamboo water spout, and snow-dusted pines.

dioramas.title: Sakura Koi Pavilion
dioramas.subtitle: Moonlit Tea Garden
dioramas.description: A timber tea pavilion with glowing shoji screens perched over a clear koi pond, arched vermilion bridge, and blooming cherry blossom canopy.

dioramas.title: Toadstool Hollow Bakery
dioramas.subtitle: Woodland Patisserie
dioramas.description: A storybook spotted-mushroom cottage with a mint striped awning, warm pastry display window, puffing stone chimney, and a napping orange cat.

dioramas.title: Midnight Alley Ramen
dioramas.subtitle: Neon Yatai Corner
dioramas.description: A wet-cobblestone backstreet noodle cart under glowing red chochin lanterns, humming retro vending machine, steaming broth pot, and a curious alley cat.

dioramas.title: Tidepool Lighthouse Cove
dioramas.subtitle: Coastal Headland
dioramas.description: A red-and-cream coastal lighthouse with glowing lantern room, blue-roofed keeper cottage, timber pier, moored rowboat, tidepool starfish, and seagull.

dioramas.title: Cloudtop Star Observatory
dioramas.subtitle: Floating Sky Island
dioramas.description: A levitating meadow island above drifting clouds, crowned with a verdigris copper dome, brass telescope, glowing cyan star-crystal, and tiny stargazer.

dioramas.title: Airmail Balloon Station
dioramas.subtitle: Sky Post Tower
dioramas.description: A round post tower with glowing portholes and a verdigris roof, a striped mail balloon moored to its walkway, and a pigeon postmaster minding the parcels.

dioramas.title: Lanternfish Listening Station
dioramas.subtitle: Cold-Water Coral Survey
dioramas.description: A brass-lamped survey fish records the reef above pink sea fans. Cut the hull beside its three portholes to see the headphones and glowing oscillograph.

dioramas.title: Coral Reef Mini-Sub
dioramas.subtitle: Deep Sea Aquarium
dioramas.description: A retro yellow-and-coral research sub hovering over a glowing reef, with a hollow furnished cockpit, an octopus riding the conning tower, jellyfish, clownfish, and sunken treasure.

dioramas.title: Saguaro Gulch Express
dioramas.subtitle: Red-Rock Trestle Railway
dioramas.description: A little blue steam engine hauls a wagon of gold over a timber trestle, across a striped canyon with a turquoise creek, past a water tower, a whistle-stop depot, a howling coyote and a patient vulture.

dioramas.title: Crater Garden Moonbase
dioramas.subtitle: Lunar Greenhouse Outpost
dioramas.description: A ribbed greenhouse dome of crops and an apple tree, a striped habitat with a dish, a red-nosed rocket on its pad, a six-wheeled rover, an astronaut planting a flag, glowing crater ice, and a tiny Earth overhead.

dioramas.title: Hilltop Flour Mill
dioramas.subtitle: Countryside Windmill
dioramas.description: A round stone windmill with four cloth sails and lit windows, a furnished room behind its open door, a duck pond, an apple tree, an old oak and a fenced meadow of wildflowers.
